Anyway, as young airmen are expendable, I was 'volunteered' to assist the Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) team on base to search and destroy old, unexploded ordinance. I got to ride around in a deuce and a half Army style truck, and with a bunch of other volunteers, search the outback areas for EOD. We used old looking olive drab metal detectors and when we found something, the real EOD people would step in, dig it up, and more times then not, blow up it up in place. The entire base, even in areas right behind the base housing is literally littered with live, dud projectiles rusting away in the sandy ground.
